threads.body: [Javaagent] A `SpanExporter` implementation is not itself discovered by agent autoconfiguration, so this migration can produce an extension that loads but is never selected by `otel.traces.exporter=zipkin`. Name the actual exporter SPI (`ConfigurableSpanExporterProvider`) and note that its runtime dependencies must be packaged with the extension.
threads.hunk:
@@ -4,6 +4,13 @@
 
 ### ⚠️ Breaking changes
 
+- The Java agent no longer bundles the Zipkin exporter, and the dedicated Spring Boot Zipkin
+  starter has been removed. To keep using Zipkin with Spring Boot, use the regular Spring Boot
+  starter and add a compatible `opentelemetry-exporter-zipkin` dependency. To keep using Zipkin
+  with the Java agent, provide a compatible `SpanExporter` provider in an extension loaded through
+  `otel.javaagent.extensions`.

replies.body:
Addressed in a3f80eb05bff4dbfd7fca00dcb5f1a8dce727064.

Warranted: the frozen CHANGELOG.md:10-11 incorrectly describes a SpanExporter provider as discoverable. The agent uses SDK service discovery via OpenTelemetryInstaller.java:32-36, and the extension example requires packaging runtime dependencies (examples/extension/build.gradle.kts:7-12). The corrected CHANGELOG.md:10-14 explicitly registers a ConfigurableSpanExporterProvider named zipkin through the service provider mechanism, packages the Zipkin exporter and runtime dependencies, and retains otel.javaagent.extensions with otel.traces.exporter=zipkin.

threads.body: [Javaagent] This breaking-change entry states what disappeared but gives no migration path. Users upgrading from the removed starter or bundled exporter need the replacement dependency/extension steps here; otherwise the release notes leave existing `otel.traces.exporter=zipkin` deployments without an actionable upgrade. Document both the regular Spring starter path and the agent `ConfigurableSpanExporterProvider` extension path.
